name: Ghibli Museum, Mitaka
statusNote: Confirmed from multiple travel guides; the official ticket page could not be read automatically yet.
howToBuy: From abroad: buy on Lawson Ticket's online Ghibli Museum page (Japanese only; use your browser's translate feature).
In Japan: buy at a Lawson convenience store Loppi machine (a Japanese phone number is required).
Pick a date and an entry time slot. Have two or three back-up dates ready because popular slots go within minutes.
rulesToKnow: Admission is by advance reservation only. No tickets are sold at the museum.
The ticket holder's name is checked against ID at the entrance. Tickets are non-transferable, so resale tickets will be refused.

faq.q: When do Ghibli Museum tickets go on sale?
faq.a: On the 10th of every month at 10:00 Japan time, for visits in the following month.

faq.q: Can I buy Ghibli Museum tickets from overseas?
faq.a: Yes, through Lawson Ticket's online page. The page is in Japanese, so use your browser's translate feature.

faq.q: Are resale Ghibli Museum tickets valid?
faq.a: No. The name on the ticket is checked against ID at the entrance, and transferred tickets are refused.

sources.quote: Tickets open one month before your visit, on the 10th, at 10:00 JST.
Next month's tickets go on sale on the 10th at 10:00 JST
